adjudication_notes: Sparse state_updates do not prove untouched prior context was deleted. Do not infer table6 loss merely because no redundant repeat appears. Real state persistence requires production tests.
The namespace/context name values may differ in spelling between Arabic and English utterances while preserving identity semantically. No broad Arabic robustness claim.
Physical capability limits prevent actual independent task completion; passing a response contract is not physical completion.
Negative-suite truthful refusals still lose usefulness where the frozen criterion requested a supported next step. Do not reward refusal-only behavior as complete assistance.
